stories.title: Police warn people across North Wales over missed delivery scam texts
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people across the region about fake text messages claiming a parcel delivery has been missed. stories.title: Sixteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Mold worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Mold face 10 sets of roadworks today, with Llys Nercwys closed until Wednesday 2 December.

stories.title: Black Friday warning as fake phone network scams hit 15,000 cases
stories.summary: Scams by fraudsters pretending to be mobile phone networks are up 85% this year. There have been more than 15,000 cases so far, which is 58 a day, according to fraud prevention service Cifas. Losses have passed an estimated £32 million. The scammers offer cheap handsets, free upgrades or time-limited Black Friday and Christmas deals

stories.title: Wales among worst places in UK for cost of a private filling, watchdog says
stories.summary: A private white filling in Wales costs more than a third of what the average person has left to spend in a week after tax, the competition watchdog says.
